attachmentTargets: one living enemy in equipped blast weapon range and LOS
neighborTargets: all living enemies at detonation; no manual target cap
directTrigger: another allied unit's direct damaging hit, after displacement/collision
deathTrigger: at attached target death position from any cause
overlap: each bomb independently damages every eligible enemy; unlike double detonation
killCredit: owner of the bomb reducing HP to zero
killEnergyLimit: once per living bomb owner per round
